attempts.scope: Full Taiwan watchgrid and attempted terminal page
attempts.result: Primary response returned 1,465 records. Terminal request used an undefined offset because the response envelope was initially treated as an array; it returned an empty no-results payload. No data was written from this attempt; corrected after inspecting the response shape.

attempts.method: Chrome DevTools page-context fetch in independent official browser tab
attempts.scope: Full Taiwan watchgrid plus firstResult=totalCount terminal check
attempts.result: HTTP 200; primary totalCount 1,465 and 1,465 result records; terminal HTTP 200 with totalCount 1,465 and 0 result records.

networkDiscovery.notes: 實際開啟渲染後的 Rolex Taiwan 型號清單及商品頁，並檢視 XHR/fetch 請求。由商品頁觀察到的同源官方請求包含 /api/catalog/watches/<RMC>?language=zh-hant 與 /api/prices/<RMC>?countryCode=TW&lang=zh-hant；本輪全量資料透過頁面同源官方 watchgrid 請求取得。未保存 cookie、token、授權標頭或個資。

responseFields.listingStatus: official product page CTA; retailer-only when only dealer referral is offered

primaryCollectionPath.pagination: 依回應 totalCount=1465，使用 firstResult offset；以 firstResult=1465 的官方請求回傳 0 筆作為終止證據。

catalogReconciliation.action: 純價格更新；不改寫 catalog 或 market。官方本輪清單與既有 catalog 參考號集合完全一致。

priceStats.taxTreatment: tax-include; Taiwan 5% per current project data; no tax schema change.

nicknameResearch.notes: 純價格更新範圍外；既有市場俗稱未變更。

nonProductWatchLinks.reason: 導覽分類連結，不含完整產品參考號，已排除於唯一腕錶數。

renderedUiEnumeration.officialUiDisplayedSearchResultText: 56 搜索結果；此數字是初始畫面標示，實際以「瀏覽更多」累積並終止後的唯一有價產品為準。
renderedUiEnumeration.reconciliation: 最終 UI 參考號集合與主要 watchgrid、既有 catalog 完全一致；全部 1,465 筆原始價格文字相符。
